sources.title: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics Releases Small, Cute & Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics has introduced Microduck, a small biped robot designed as an open development platform for experimenting with physical AI, reinforcement learning and transferring robot behaviors from simulation into real hardware.

sources.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: A $399 Open-Source Robot for AI ...
sources.snippet: The launch of Microduck by Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics signifies a notable step in making advanced robotics and embodied AI development more accessible. With its open-source software, diverse capabilities, and developer-focused design, Microduck provides a platform for innovation in physical AI.
